summary.name: Path Finder
summary.one_liner: Path Finder is a macOS file manager from Cocoatech that serves as an alternative to the Finder, with dual-pane browsing, Dropbox integration, and folder sync.
use_cases: replace the macOS Finder with a more featured file browser
copy or move files between two panes
synchronize and compare folders on a Mac
securely delete files so they cannot be recovered
browse files on a USB-connected iPhone
visualize folder sizes to find what takes up disk space
summary.what_it_does: Path Finder is a file management app for macOS. It offers a dual-pane browser where files can be copied from one pane to the other with a single click, and a Drop Stack that holds files in a temporary stack during drag-and-drop copy or move operations. It includes FolderSync for folder comparison and synchronization, batch rename and advanced selection by name, extension or attributes, and bookmarks, tab presets, and path-based search. Its Size Browser, Hierarchical Columns View and Hierarchical Chart View show files by size and hierarchy. The page also mentions browsing files on USB-connected iOS devices and Dropbox account linking.
notable: Dual-pane browser with Drop Stack for copy and move operations
FolderSync folder comparison and synchronization tool
Size Browser and hierarchical chart view for visualizing folder sizes
caveats: Purchasing requires a subscription or license key, and the page offers a 30-day free trial
Browsing an iPhone applies to USB-connected iOS devices only
Page describes Path Finder 10 and older Path Finder 8 versions; current availability of old versions is not detailed
